title: Uncawamuck (Reeve's Creek)
summary: Uncawamuck is a creek placename near Mattituck, associated with a canoe portage and the Ocquebauck land-title landscape.
history_content: The name belongs to the Riverhead/Southold boundary landscape around the eastern side of the Ocquebauck tract. Time-specific deed context is handled as a Timeline Entry with its own reference.
translation_content:
Recorded forms and cross-references include Uncawamuck, Unkawa, and Unkechaug. The name is interpreted as the further fishing-place.

Why Place Names Matter

“Embracing First Nations languages in place names is one very easy way to help our languages live on.”

— Aunty Geraldine Atkinson, Call for more First Nations place names on International Mother Language Day (2023), Direct quotation, paragraph 6
preservation_content: Uncawamuck preserves a portage and fishing-place memory in the waterways between Peconic Bay and Mattituck.
whereintheworld_content: Blue/general approximate marker near Mattituck Creek/Reeve's Creek. This is a modern orientation point, not an exact historic creek boundary or portage coordinate.
